metadata.description: ADMOS operations plugins for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Currently: publish an HTML report to the ADMOS reports host and share it with a publisher, with explicit human approval.

plugins.name: admos-reports
plugins.description: Bundle a report into one self-contained HTML file, upload it to the ADMOS reports host and share it with a publisher. Publishing needs an explicit yes from the operator, and the client should also ask before the approve call.
